questions.q: What was Iran called in the West until 1935?
questions.why: Iranians have long called it Iran.

questions.q: Which king founded the Achaemenid Persian Empire?
questions.why: His cylinder is called an early charter of rights.

questions.q: Which 1979 event ended Iran's monarchy?
questions.why: Ayatollah Khomeini returned from exile.

questions.q: Which war did Iran fight against Iraq from 1980 to 1988?
questions.why: It ended in a stalemate.

questions.q: Which Achaemenid king invaded Greece and fought at Thermopylae?
questions.why: He lost the naval battle of Salamis.

questions.q: Which Iranian lawyer won the 2003 Nobel Peace Prize?
questions.why: She was the first Muslim woman to win it.

questions.q: Which 1906 revolution gave Iran its first parliament?
questions.why: The Majlis was founded.

questions.q: Which ancient city in Fars holds the tomb of Cyrus the Great?
questions.why: It is a UNESCO site.

questions.q: Which ceremonial capital was built by Darius I?
questions.why: Alexander the Great burned it.

questions.q: Which Safavid shah made Isfahan his capital?
questions.why: He built its great square.

questions.q: What is the capital of Iran?
questions.why: It lies below the Alborz mountains.

questions.q: Which sea lies north of Iran?
questions.why: It is the world's largest lake.

questions.q: Which gulf lies south of Iran?
questions.why: The Strait of Hormuz is its mouth.

questions.q: Which city is famous for its 'Image of the World' square?
questions.why: Naqsh-e Jahan Square is a UNESCO site.

questions.q: What is Iran's highest mountain?
questions.why: It is a dormant volcano.

questions.q: Which desert city is famous for its wind-catcher towers?
questions.why: Its old town is a UNESCO site.

questions.q: Which celebration of the longest night features pomegranates?
questions.why: Families read Hafez's poems.

questions.q: Which Iranian mathematician won the Fields Medal in 2014?
questions.why: She was the first woman to win it.

questions.q: Which Iranian director won Oscars for 'A Separation' and 'The Salesman'?
questions.why: Both won Best Foreign Language Film.

questions.q: Which poet wrote the 'Shahnameh' (Book of Kings)?
questions.why: It took him about 30 years.

questions.q: Which poet's tomb in Shiraz draws many readers?
questions.why: Iranians open his poems to tell fortunes.

questions.q: Which poet and astronomer wrote the 'Rubaiyat'?
questions.why: He also helped reform the calendar.

questions.q: Which physician wrote 'The Canon of Medicine'?
questions.why: It was used in Europe for centuries.

questions.q: What was the title of Iran's kings?
questions.why: The last shah was Mohammad Reza Pahlavi.

questions.q: What is the Persian New Year called?
questions.why: It begins at the spring equinox.

questions.q: Iran is the world's top producer of which spice from crocus flowers?
questions.why: Most comes from Khorasan.

questions.q: What is Iran's currency?
questions.why: People often count prices in tomans.

questions.q: Which hand-knotted floor coverings is Iran famous for?
questions.why: Tabriz and Isfahan are famous centres.

questions.q: Which crispy golden rice crust is a Persian favourite?
questions.why: It forms at the bottom of the pot.

questions.q: Which herb stew with kidney beans is often called the national dish?
questions.why: It is flavoured with dried lime.
